resources.string: Why it happened
What you can do
Raw error
Cooldown remaining: %1$s
Request timed out
The source server did not respond in time; the site may be slow or busy.
Try again later. If it keeps happening, check the source mirror or your connection.
Rate limited (429)
Too many requests were sent to the source in a short time; the server is temporarily delaying requests.
Wait for the cooldown to expire before retrying. The app temporarily pauses requests to this source.
Cloudflare / CAPTCHA
The site\'s bot protection redirected the request to a verification page.
Open the source in a browser and complete verification; if needed, change your network or VPN settings.
Chapter or page not found
The requested chapter or page may have been removed, or the source URL structure may have changed.
Try another chapter. If this happens across many titles, the extension may need an update.
Network or DNS error
The device could not reach the source address; DNS, connectivity, or TLS may be at fault.
Check your internet and DNS settings, then try another network. The source server may also be offline.
Session / authentication
The source may require a login, cookies, or valid authentication.
Sign in to the source again if needed and review the extension settings.
Source format changed
The site\'s HTML or API may have changed, so the extension cannot parse the expected content.
Update the extension. If the issue persists, report it to the extension repository.
Unclassified error
The error did not match any known source diagnostic signature.
Try again. Include the code and raw error message when reporting the issue.
Site protection blocked the request
Cloudflare, a WAF, DDoS-Guard, or similar bot verification interrupted the stream request.
Verify the source in a browser. If needed, change your VPN, DNS, or network and try again.
Plugin unsupported or unhealthy
The plugin does not implement a required search/stream method, or repeated failures caused it to be blocked for this session.
Update the plugin or try another source; check the latest error in the diagnostic screen.
No streams found
The plugin ran, but the server returned an empty stream list for this title; the content may have been removed or not added yet.
Try another plugin or title variant. If only one title fails, the source may not carry it.
Plugin request timed out
The plugin or provider did not respond within the allowed time.
Try again later; if other plugins work, the provider may be having an issue.
Rate limited
The provider temporarily limited requests (HTTP 429).
Wait a while before retrying; avoid repeated refreshes.
Network / DNS error
The device or plugin could not connect to the provider\'s server.
Check your connection and DNS settings. Try again on another network.
Plugin parsing error
A change to the provider\'s page/API format prevented the plugin from reading its response.
Update the plugin. If it continues on the latest version, report it to the plugin repository.
Plugin account required
The source requires an account or login credentials before it can search.
Open the plugin settings and configure the required account. This source cannot work without it.
Plugin runtime incompatibility
The CS3 plugin referenced a runtime class that is missing or incompatible in the app\'s dynamic plugin loader.
Update the app. If it continues, share the live trace report; this is an app/plugin compatibility issue.
Unclassified plugin error
The error did not match any known CloudStream diagnostic signature.
Try again and share this code with the diagnostic report.
